notes.title: Open Beta test will be conducted!
notes.content:
Notice: Open Beta Test for Latest Update
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456613/b06af917e40a193d5492b97da3b3c7afe976b615.png"]

We have identified a bug in RayStorm and RayStorm NEO-HD (included in the Steam version of Ray’z Arcade Chronology) where the application may crash when Player 2 selects R-GRAY1. We plan to release a patch to address this issue, but since the changes could affect multiple parts of the game, we will conduct an open beta test first.

How to Join the Test:
[olist]
In the Steam client Library, right-click Ray’z Arcade Chronology in your game list and select \[Properties].

In the window that appears, select \[Betas] from the left menu. Under Private Betas, enter the beta access code palmyravalley and click \[Check Code].

Once authenticated, use the pull-down menu to select the beta branch.

From the left menu, select \[Updates], and in the Automatic Updates pull-down, choose “Always keep this game updated.”

Close the window and return to your Library. Select Ray’z Arcade Chronology from the list.

If the update does not start automatically and the usual “Play” button shows “Update” instead, click it manually.

Once the update is complete, launch the game as normal from the Play button.
[/olist]
The open beta test is scheduled to run from August 29, 2025 through September 16, 2025 (JST).
If you notice any issues during the test, please leave a comment in this topic or post on the Ray’z Arcade Chronology store page discussion board.

We appreciate your cooperation!



Note: This bug fix does not affect RayForce, RayCrisis, or RayCrisis HD.
Note: Participation in the open beta requires that Ray’z Arcade Chronology is already registered in your Steam Library.
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Operation: Night Strikers Day, Aug 15th in Akihabara!
notes.content:
All units: converge on Akihabara!
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41309941/af01ee55df0eb91e34050fde7363d4add814e8a4.png
On August 15, we’re holding a special Night Striker-focused event above the Hey arcade in Akihabara, Tokyo. The venue will feature merchandise sales—including limited and early-release items—an actual arcade Night Striker cabinet on display, and a hands-on play area.

In the morning, we’ll host the “Night Striker Special Tactical Action Force Skills Trial in Hey” competition. Players will take on designated stages, competing for the highest Running Point score (displayed on the game’s gadget) at stage end. Entry is limited to 20 participants; if applications exceed this number, players will be selected at random. Those wishing to participate should register at the Hey 2F counter between 10:00 and 10:15 on the day of the event.

At 15:00, we present the “Monthly ZUNTATA NIGHT – Special Summer 2025 Edition in Hey”. Guests will include M2 development staff from Operation Night Strikers and Night Striker GEAR, showcasing live gameplay and delivering talks from the sound creators. The session will also be streamed live on YouTube—so if you can’t attend in person, join us online!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BqSo6EPjoL8(Stream available in Japanese only.)

notes.title: Shooters Fes 2025: See Operation Night Strikers live!
notes.content:
A hail of lead is heading to Tokyo!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298709/af01ee55df0eb91e34050fde7363d4add814e8a4.png"]

Taito will be showing Operation Night Strikers and Night Strikers Gear during a live stream at Shooter Fes 2025, an online event focused on shooting games and organised by City Connection and Game Centre Mikado. The event runs over two days; June 14th and 15th with livestreams starting at 12:00 on each day.



The team from Taito will be on stream from 18:00 on Saturday 14th, with producer Yuichi Toyama and Zuntata’s Katsuhisa Ishikawa being joined by guests Naoki Horii and Hibana Yokeru from developers M2. Learn all about the game play and sounds of Operation Night Strikers Night Strikers Gear while seeing the games in action and listening to the music. 



The stream will run on Mikado’s YouTube channel and can be viewed live at Red Bull Gaming Sphere Tokyo.

notes.title: Steam Deck compatibility update
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who tested the beta branch release (see here), the updates are now live in the main branch.

Note: there are no updates to the game/s itself and, while it fixes the majority of issues reported, we are still looking into some outlying reports.

We hope you enjoy locking-on to portable shooting fun!
